newsitem.title: USA: 3Com CEO says new products to help margins.
newsitem.headline: 3Com CEO says new products to help margins.

text.p: 3Com Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Eric Benhamou said the company may top its 52 to 54 percent gross margin target in coming quarters, boosted by a shifting product mix and strong new products.

In a presentation at an American Electronics Association investment conference, Benhamou said the company was considering raising its financial target range, but a decision would not be announced until early in 1997.
The world market for networking equipment is still expected to grow at about 40 percent this year, and 3Com continues to aim for stronger growth of its businesses, he said.
